title: A New Game in an Old Factory
paras: In the mountain town of Bellara, visitors can try curling inside a former cloth factory. Bright cloth once hung from its roof, but some dyes contained [[poison|poison]]. Production ended long ago, and the building was carefully cleaned before becoming an ice hall. A small display by the entrance tells this unusual story.

I arrived on Saturday evening and made my [[payment|payment]] at a wooden desk. Renting shoes and equipment together offered a [[saving|saving]] of five euros. My ticket carried a six-digit [[code|code]], which opened a locker. Inside the hall, our [[cheerful|cheerful]] guide, Mina, introduced herself as last year's town curling [[champion|champion]].

Before we began, Mina used a [[torch|torch]] to examine a dark corner beside the ice. She had noticed a [[crack|crack]] in the wooden floor and placed a chair over it. Then she showed us how to [[slide|slide]] a heavy stone towards a painted circle. The [[maximum|maximum]] group size was eight, so everyone had several turns. My first stone stopped far too early; my second reached the circle.

Afterwards, we drank hot apple juice beneath photographs of factory workers. Mina explained that several workers' families still played here every winter. Looking from their old photographs to the busy ice, I felt that the building had gained a new life without losing its past.
zh: 在山城贝拉拉，游客可以在一座旧布厂里体验冰壶运动。鲜艳的布料曾经悬挂在屋顶下，但一些染料含有有毒物质。工厂早已停产，厂房经过彻底清理后，改成了冰场。入口旁的一个小展区讲述了这段不同寻常的历史。
我在星期六傍晚到达，在一张木桌前付了钱。鞋子和装备一起租，可以省下五欧元。票上有一个六位数的密码，可以用来打开储物柜。走进冰场，我们那位开朗的教练米娜介绍说，她是去年镇上冰壶比赛的冠军。
开始前，米娜用手电筒检查了冰面旁一个昏暗的角落。她发现木地板上有一道裂缝，便放了一把椅子挡住那里。接着，她教我们怎样让沉重的冰壶滑向画好的圆圈。每组最多八个人，所以每个人都能练上好几次。我的第一壶停得太早，第二壶则滑进了圆圈。
活动结束后，我们在工厂工人的照片下喝热苹果汁。米娜说，有几户工人家庭至今仍会在每年冬天来这里玩。我看看那些老照片，又望向热闹的冰场，觉得这座建筑获得了新生，却没有丢掉自己的过去。

q.s: The factory became an ice hall without being cleaned first.
q.why: 厂房先经过仔细清理，才改成冰场。

q.s: Renting shoes and equipment together saved five euros.
q.why: 原文明确说一起租可省五欧元。

q.s: Mina's grandparents worked in the cloth factory.
q.why: 未提米娜的祖父母或外祖父母是否在厂里工作。
